notes: The input contains no study, outcome or test locators. The named primary replication report identifies a single-trace claim targeting the quarterly Table 2 regression, allowing independent alignment to the original paper. Original title, authors and DOI match the supplied reference; replication report title, original citation, OSF project bawh3 and SCORE RR ID 249w6 match the supplied replication reference. Original acquired from the author-hosted published PDF after the DOI landing page returned a challenge and Unpaywall/OpenAlex provided no OA location. No metric conversion or p-value calculation performed. Original adjusted R-squared is also printed as 6.82%, but the extracted effect is the printed slope coefficient matching the main replication test. Analytic n is not explicitly printed in either examined document and remains null. The authors separately report that the pre-Covid robustness test replicated the claim (coefficient 0.4196571, p = 0.03437405); these values are not mixed with the main test. Reported success refers specifically to the main test.
